notes.title: Try out demo of our new game - Plow the Snow !
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hello dear Players![/h1][/b]

We got special announcement for you!
We wanna invite you - [b]Players [/b]to check out a demo for a new game that we are developing!
This game is called [i]Plow the Snow![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c1d67ad0b06f2c99e712213c149b3100db3b3f16.png[/img]

What is it game about? It is a [b]simulator[/b] and [b]casual relaxing[/b] game with a bit cartoony stylized graphic centered around getting rid of the snow in various places !
Help your clients and neighbors get through this winter season. 
You can use multiple machines and brave any obstacle in your path to make the sidewalks and streets free from the snowflake menace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/0231325a478a41b61da6d57cded1bef56bbd869f.gif[/img]

[h3]What can you expect in demo version? 
[/h3]

[h3]-Two different levels + garage !

-Great stylized graphic and atmosphere

-Relaxing gameplay and music.

-Fixing stuff in your vehicle in garage! 

-A lot of fun (and a lot of snow to plow) ![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7c07d517acd343d39317b60bf8e6152be0b7a9c1.gif[/img]

Full version will have a lot of levels and also a multiplayer!

Put your gloves on, warm jackets and be ready to Plow the Snow!
Don’t wait, help Snow Angeles to clean up the snow in city !
[h2]Download demo on Steam and don’t forget to wishlist the full game 😉[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967530/Plow_the_Snow/

Players feedback was always close in our hearts and we want to fulfill every player's desire !
Tell us in comments, on Steam Community or on our Discord server what was your's feelings about game ;)

Enjoy and have fun!

Baked Games Team
